meta.title: Claude UI + ClaudePet
meta.description: Unofficial Claude-style skin for the DSH Web UI: cream canvas, serif answers, Claude wording, Opus/Sonnet model labels and a Claude provider label in model menus. On Windows the plugin also starts ClaudePet, a transparent always-on-top desktop companion with expressions, drag, notes and sounds; disabling the bundle stops the pet. The pet is a local unsigned executable copied to %LOCALAPPDATA%\ClaudePet\app, with logs and heartbeat under %APPDATA%\ClaudePet. Model labels are presentation-only and do not change routing. Not affiliated with Anthropic or DeepSeek.
